      function log(...args) {
        console.log(...args);
        const pre = document.createElement("pre");
        pre.innerText = args.join(" ");
        document.body.append(pre);
      }

      function logObj(obj) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2));
      }

      function getSomeUsers(url) {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("GET", url, true);
        xhr.responseType = "arraybuffer";
        userIds = ["user1@mailinator.com", "user2@mailinator.com"];
        userHashes = ["01afb3d228ab18bd34806aa16b7a255744656b98c5fd526c3e479f1d93e8a44"];
        xhr.setRequestHeader("userIds", userIds);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("userHashes", userHashes);
        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
        };
        xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
          log("readyState:", xhr.readyState);
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function run(url) {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("GET", url, true);
        xhr.responseType = "arraybuffer";
        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
        };
        xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
          log("readyState:", xhr.readyState);
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function runWithHeaders(url, headers) {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("GET", url, true);
        xhr.responseType = "arraybuffer";
        for (const property in headers) {
          xhr.setRequestHeader(property, headers[property]);
        }
        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
        };
        xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
          log("readyState:", xhr.readyState);
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function runJson(url, headers) {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("GET", url, true);
        xhr.responseType = "json";
        for (const property in headers) {
          xhr.setRequestHeader(property, headers[property]);
        }
        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
          logObj(xhr.response);
        };
        xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
          log("readyState:", xhr.readyState);
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function runGetActiveDevices(url) {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("GET", url, true);
        xhr.responseType = "json";
        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
          const deviceArray = xhr.response;
          for (let i = 0; i < deviceArray.length; i++) {
            let obj = deviceArray[i];
            log(obj.appId);
            log(obj.description);
            log(obj.type);
            log(obj.lastLoginTime);
            log(obj.thisDevice);

        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function runPut(url) {
        //console.log("action:", action)
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("PUT", url, true);
        // xhr.setRequestHeader("action", action)

        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
        };
        xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
          log("readyState:", xhr.readyState);
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          console.log("error status", JSON.stringify(xhr), xhr.status);
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        xhr.onloadend = function () {
          console.log("error status", xhr, xhr.status);
          if (xhr.status == 404) throw new Error(url + " replied 404");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function runPost(url, msg) {
        console.log("msg:", msg);
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open("POST", url, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("newmessage", encodeURI(msg));

        xhr.onload = () => {
          log("loaded. status:", xhr.status);
          log("loaded. data:", xhr.response);
        };
        xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
          log("readyState:", xhr.readyState);
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => {
          console.log("error status", JSON.stringify(xhr), xhr.status);
          log("xhr error!");
        };
        xhr.onloadend = function () {
          console.log("error status", xhr, xhr.status);
          if (xhr.status == 404) throw new Error(url + " replied 404");
        };
        log("sending:", url);
        xhr.send();
      }

      function uiAction(action) {
        log(`sending action ${action}`);
        let a = {
          action: action,
        };

        if (action === "imagePreview" || action === "openFile" || action === "saveFile" || action === "locationPopup" || action === "joinCall" || action === "messageHistory" || action === "reactionPopup" || action === "deleteMessage" || action == "showMessageError") {
          // Make sure these vgroupIds and messageIds map to real messages
          a["vgroupId"] = "";
          a["messageId"] = "";
          a["savedImage"] = "7219f5ae-b34d-4092-bf52-6a50a809f4cb";
        }

        if (action === "locationPopup") {
          a["vgroupId"] = "Sff079cb05843ff0dfc3f13a413a7885336849addcee2a46fe52d18336ed30d0";
          a["messageId"] = "aadb921041fa11eebdc5ab82cbd66ba5";
        }

        if (action === "openLink") {
          // this must be extracted from a link preview or detected by the UI when hovering over a link
          a["link"] = "https://www.amazon.com";
          a["showConfirmation"] = false;
        }

        if (action === "viewContactDetails" || action === "reportUser") {
          a["userId"] = "dory34@mailinator.com";
        }

        if (action === "showMessageDialog") {
          a["message"] = "This is a message";
          a["title"] = "This is a title";
        }

        if (action === "securityVerification") {
          a["userId"] = "nemo@mailinator.com";
        }

        if (action === "toggleFileDropArea") {
          a["active"] = false;
        }

        wickrUiBridge.sendAction(a);
      }

      function msgAction(action) {
        log(`sending action ${action}`);
        let a = {
          action: action,
        };

        if (action === "starMessage" || action === "unstarMessage" || action === "saveFileToRoom" || action === "saveLinkToRoom" || action === "emojiReact" || action === "translateMessage") {
          // Make sure these vgroupIds and messageIds map to real messages
          a["vgroupId"] = "Sf5c03eed1179410ba8d74bdf9fa74ee79e574173fe1ab21db735ed12d346490";
          a["messageId"] = "9293de60d1c911eeae51e9c9efa35df6";
        }

        if (action === "clearMessageTempId") {
          // Make sure these vgroupIds and messageIds map to real messages
          a["vgroupId"] = "b3923c46516d17daba218857c5bee6b33331e2dced5df3d6041c4cf61748a322";
          a["tempMessageId"] = "ca4e7a2f4cdce1bfddbfaa6fca37d01ea8fb3e8b854e28500de2fd79bd7e83ee";

          wickrBridge.clearMessageTempId(a, function (success) {
            log("Server message id:", success["serverMessageId"]);
          });
        }

        if (action === "saveFileToRoom") {
          a["vgroupId"] = "S400073b7ecff52357a9b253ed247c9477e152f4d185aa9d04ab85cd8fedad4a";
          a["messageId"] = "339cd430439811eeb1fd959bbab42d8f";

          wickrBridge.saveFileToRoom(a);
        }

        if (action === "saveLinkToRoom") {
          // this must be extracted from a link preview or detected by the UI when hovering over a link
          a["vgroupId"] = "S400073b7ecff52357a9b253ed247c9477e152f4d185aa9d04ab85cd8fedad4a";
          a["messageId"] = "555a1100439811eeb1fd959bbab42d8f";

          a["link"] = "https://www.amazon.com";
          wickrBridge.saveLinkToRoom(a);
        }

        if (action === "starMessage") {
          a["star"] = true;
          wickrBridge.starMessage(a, function (success) {
            log(success);
          });
        }

        if (action === "getAwsCredentials") {
          // Please set keys here to test translate
          a["accessKeyId"] = "";
          a["secretKey"] = "";
          wickrBridge.getAwsCredentials(a, function (success) {
            log(success);
          });
        }

        if (action === "translateMessage") {
          wickrBridge.translateMessage(a, function (success) {
            log(success);
          });
        }
        if (action === "showTranslationSettings") {
          wickrBridge.showTranslationSettings(function (success) {
            log(success);
          });
        }

        if (action === "emojiReact") {
          a["emoji"] = "😊";
          //a["remove"] = true;
          wickrBridge.emojiReact(a, function (success) {
            log(success);
          });
        }

        if (action === "unstarMessage") {
          a["star"] = false;
          wickrBridge.starMessage(a, function (success) {
            log(success);
          });
        }
      }

      let uploadUUID = "";
      function pinNewFile() {
        options = {
          title: "Upload file",
        };

        const parentFolder = "5d6b344d-e4d9-468f-ba3a-357944a98001";
        fileManager.showOpenDialog(options, function (r) {
          if ("fileName" in r) {
            fileName = r["fileName"];
            size = r["size"];
            log("file name:", fileName);
            log("file size:", size);
            if (fileName.length > 0) {
              r["vgroupId"] = currentVgroupId;
              r["parentFolder"] = parentFolder;
              r["renamedFile"] = "renamed2";
              fileManager.pinNewFile(r, function (u) {
                logObj(u);
                uploadUUID = u["uuid"];
                log("new pinned file: ", uploadUUID);
              });
            }
          } else {
            console.log("The user did not select a file");
          }
        });
      }

      // non API related, used to hide and show buttons underneath each header
      function headerClicked(buttonGroup) {
        if (buttonGroup === "") {
          log("No button group provided");
        } else {
          var displayStatus = document.getElementById(buttonGroup).style.display;

          if (displayStatus === "none") {
            displayStatus = "block";
          } else {
            displayStatus = "none";
          }

          document.getElementById(buttonGroup).style.display = displayStatus;
        }
      }

      async function testShowSaveFileDialog() {
        try {
          // Call the API and await the response
          const response = await wickrOnboardingBridge.showSaveFileDialog();
          
          // Log the response for debugging
          console.log('Save dialog response:', JSON.stringify(response));

          // Test the response structure
          if (response.success) {
            console.log('File saved successfully');
          } else if (response.error) {
            console.log('Dialog result:', response.error);
          } else {
            console.error('Unexpected response format:', response);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error in save dialog:', error);
        }
      }

      // can be used to benchmark a single iteration of an API call
      // to call: benchmark(functionName, [arg1, arg2, arg3, ...])
      async function benchmark(buttonFunction, args) {
        const start = performance.now();
        const temp = await buttonFunction.apply(this, args);
        const end = performance.now();
        log(buttonFunction.name, "took", end - start, "ms");
      }
